original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：火灾烧毁莫阿蒂泽区司法法院部分设施
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克太特省莫阿蒂泽区司法法院第三庭于周四（22日）上午发生火灾，多起民事案件卷宗被烧毁。据Notícias Online报道，该庭截至上月底约有2000宗涉及债务、婚姻、土地及未成年人等事务的案件。火灾原因尚未查明，有人推测可能是早上6时左右的短路所致，法院承诺近日就此作出说明。

location.site: 莫阿蒂泽区司法法院第三庭
location.raw_text: Third Section of the District Judicial Court of Moatize, in Tete province

key_facts.fact: 莫阿蒂泽区司法法院第三庭发生火灾，多起民事案件卷宗被毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Files relating to several civil cases were destroyed in a fire that broke out on Thursday morning (22) in the Third Section of the District Judicial Court of Moatize, in Tete province.

key_facts.fact: 该庭截至上月底约有2000宗案件，涉及债务、婚姻、土地及未成年人等事务
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: by the end of last month, this court section now destroyed by the fire had around 2,000 cases relating to debts, marriages, land, matters involving minors and other issues

key_facts.fact: 火灾原因尚未查明，有人推测可能是早上6时左右的短路所致
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The cause of the fire is not yet known, although it is thought that it may have been caused by a short circuit at around 6:00 a.m.

key_facts.fact: 法院承诺近日就该事件作出说明
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The court has promised to comment on the incident in the coming days.

uncertainties: 火灾原因尚未查明，短路说法仅为推测
目前仅有一个来源（Club of Mozambique）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
